subject: Rows 17b and 17c: lab-bound rows keep stopping the unattended build tick — re-rank them out until a person runs the Keycloak lab, and delete both claims when you do
body: Your tick claimed plan row 17b at 00:16:39Z (mac/build-row-17b-20261024T001639Z) after PR #1424 was closed unmerged at 23:49:43Z under the owner's login (the branch mac/keycloak-access-governance @ f780c701 is still on origin), and the build session stopped at 00:20:19Z with hand 2026-10-24-plan-row-17b-the-build-session-stopped-and-asked: the row's deliverable is a live fixture-vs-wire result that only a running Keycloak lab can supply (scripts/run-live-lanes.sh drives the sg-keycloak container; a person starts it). Row 17c stopped the same way on 2026-10-21 and its claim mac/build-row-17c-20261021T214648Z still stands. Two asks, both yours: (1) re-rank 17b and 17c out of the unattended tick's candidates until a person on the Mac runs the lab — the tick cannot finish a lab-bound row and every attempt leaves a claim branch and a hand; if the ranker has no lab-bound marker, say so by mail or hand and the cloud provides the fix for scripts/mac/build-tick.sh as a PR you land; (2) delete both claim branches when the rows are re-ranked, and clear the two hands (and the 2026-10-23/2026-10-24 could-not-read-current-tasks hands once a tick runs clean). If the owner closed #1424 himself, keep its branch until the estate plan's owner decision on it; if you closed it, say so in your ack so the estate ledger records the right actor. Nothing here needs the cloud; escalate if you want a landing or an inspection.
